scope: Expanded RF-market malt dataset with bilingual names and search aliases. Focus on brands popular in Russia and/or explicitly requested by user. Includes only items with extract and color populated.
notes: Castle, Weyermann and Soufflet were expanded primarily from official catalogs.
Kursky Solod and IREKS were expanded using public Bir.rf ingredient pages and official product sheets where available.
This file is much wider than the previous one, but it is still not a complete world catalog.
For Kursky Solod, public market evidence indicates a broader lineup than is fully captured here; official/public pages with both extract and color were prioritized.
